intro: Armenian media focus on constitutional reform debates, EU integration steps, and cross-border dialogue with Azerbaijan, while also reporting on economic agreements and international developments.

topics.title: Constitutional reform and snap election debate
topics.text: Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan has floated the possibility of snap parliamentary elections while defending the draft constitution, stating that not all proposals will be accepted and outlining his red lines. CivilNet reports that Yerevan is drafting a new constitution, and the Justice Minister clarified that Armenian Genocide recognition was never an explicit constitutional provision.

topics.title: Armenia–Azerbaijan dialogue and border talks
topics.text: Officials from both countries continue engagement under the "Peace Bridge" initiative, with civil society representatives holding a fifth meeting and the Security Council secretary planning a visit to Azerbaijan in early December. Alen Simonyan noted that bilateral relations will be discussed during a planned visit, while Farhad Mammadov called the continued dialogue an achievement in itself.

topics.title: EU integration and border modernization
topics.text: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development will lend Armenia up to €19.6 million to modernize border checkpoints. Prime Minister Pashinyan ruled out repealing the EU accession law, and the head of the EU delegation met with Armenian officials to discuss cooperation.

topics.title: Economic cooperation and trade updates
topics.text: Azerbaijan exported products worth nearly $23.7 million to Armenia in January–October, and the economy minister said Armenia will appeal to a Eurasian court over Russian restrictions on goods. The government allocated 4.47 billion drams for agricultural export support, and a new data center will be established in Aragatsotn Province.

topics.title: International incidents: Egypt fire and SpaceX authorization
topics.text: At least 31 people were killed in Egypt after a fuel tanker crash ignited a huge fire near Cairo, prompting Armenia to offer condolences. The US authorized SpaceX to deploy one million satellites for data centers in space.

topics.title: Domestic economic measures and banking news
topics.text: Ardshinbank offers 10% cashback to premium cardholders for Black Friday and won "Armenia Deal of the Year" at the Global Banking & Markets Awards 2026. Unibank announced 50% off card issuance, and Armeconombank provides 10% cashback at cinemas with its Visa Student Card.

topics.title: Cultural events and sports appointments
topics.text: The Khachaturian International Festival brings 20 days of music to Yerevan, and Olympic champion Elen Bunatyants was appointed head coach of Armenia's U20 women's basketball team. The European Deaf Wrestling Championships opened in Tsaghkadzor.
